mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_name FROM users u JOIN role r ON JSON_CONTAINS(u.role, CAST(r.id AS CHAR)) JOIN permission p ON JSON_CONTAINS(r.permissions, CAST(p.id AS CHAR)) WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.status = 1
SELECT job, ref_id AS refId FROM users WHERE id = #{id}
